name: facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.implement_create_map_mask_MapLocDataset: implement a method to create a boolean map mask around the center of a canvas with configurable radius and padding

facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.rectify_image_with_roll: rectify a torch image tensor using a camera model and roll angle with bilinear grid sampling
facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.rectify_image_with_roll_and_pitch: rectify a torch image tensor using a camera model with both roll and pitch Euler angles

facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.pad_image_with_crop_and_center: pad or crop a torch image tensor to a target size with optional center cropping and camera adjustment

facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.chunk_sequence_split_trajectory: chunk a sequence of camera indices into segments by distance, time delay, and max length constraints
facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.chunk_sequence_filter_by_distance: split trajectory indices into chunks where inter-sample distance exceeds a maximum threshold
facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.chunk_sequence_filter_by_time: chunk camera sequence indices by maximum time delay between consecutive captures in seconds

facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.random_flip_image_raster: randomly flip an image and map raster horizontally or vertically and update coordinates and heading
facebookresearch_orienternet/maploc/data.decompose_rotmat_euler: decompose a camera to world rotation matrix into roll pitch and yaw Euler angles
